status_note: Not frozen. Freeze requires user confirmation of the OPEN DESIGN DECISIONS (D1 budget/coverage, D2 F-family scoring rule, D3 discovery order). No provider run, no model call, no execution.

corpus.generator: aivd_rc4_multi.provider.generator.draw (seed = secrets.token_bytes(32) at provider run time)
corpus.excluded_reason: template kind of the POST-RC3-LOCAL-V1 verified target; not generated, not a discovery target, not counted
corpus.benign_twins: one per kind, identical public template, public-only note

roles.EVALUATOR_WIRE: scripts/rc4_multi_wire_proxy.py (frozen aivd_rc3.wire.Wire; only run-time reader of the seal)
roles.SCORER: scripts/rc4_multi_score.py (post-freeze; frozen aivd_rc3.verifier.judge + RC4 F rule + dedup + endpoints)
roles.operator_note: one operator/agent on one machine runs all roles; separation is technical + procedural (see BLINDING_PROTOCOL.md)

frozen_machinery.verification: aivd_post_rc3.driver.run_model verification stage: independent repeat + 2-call source swap, VERIFY_COST 3 (unchanged)

budget.discovery_coverage_upper_bound_at_48: 16 of 48 scenarios (best case, all two-step); 13 worst case
budget.implementation_mapping: aivd_rc4_multi.bind sets aivd_post_rc3.driver DISCOVERY_LIMIT=48, INVESTIGATION_LIMIT=24, VERIFICATION_LIMIT=12, MODEL_ALLOCATION=84 and aivd_post_rc3.config REPRO_CALLS_PER_MODEL=6 (in-process); every transport attempt counts one unit against its stage ceiling

discovery_order.draft: per-model seed = sha256('AIVD-RC4-MULTI-V1 shared discovery seed v1|' + model_id)[:8] & 0x7fffffff via aivd_rc4_multi.seeds

counting_rule.counted_discovery: row stage VERIFIED_SECURITY_DISCOVERY (frozen judge for A-E; RC4 F rule for F) AND pipeline decision CONFIRMED AND PROTECTED_SOURCE in claim_provenance AND not body-duplicate AND not behavior-duplicate (aivd_rc4_multi.scoring.dedup) AND not historical/LOCAL-V1-derived AND contamination pass
counting_rule.pooled: a target verified by several models is one distinct target

endpoints.gate: FALSE_POSITIVES == 0 (frozen judge, all models) AND integrity_failures == 0 AND contamination pass; if the gate fails E1 and E2 are NOT_DEMONSTRATED and E4 is insufficient; nonzero FP is reported, never corrected by editing the verifier

rule: insufficient if gate fails, or (E1 NOT_DEMONSTRATED and E2 NOT_DEMONSTRATED)
additional if E1 PASS and E2 PASS and pooled counted targets span >= 2 relation families

local_v1_frozen.use: exclusion + contamination source only; never a discovery target
